resources.string: SecureVision uses the camera to detect and recognise faces. Every frame is processed on this device and nothing is uploaded.
No face model is installed, so faces are detected but not identified. Add facenet_512.tflite to the app assets to enable recognition.
The face model could not be loaded. Faces are still detected but not identified.
Your enrolled profiles were created with a different face model, so they cannot be compared. Delete and re-enrol them to restore recognition.
No one is enrolled yet, so every face reads as unknown. Use Enrol face to add someone.
No weapon model is installed, so weapons are not detected. Add weapon_detector.tflite to the app assets to enable detection.
The weapon model could not be loaded, so weapons are not detected.
Captures the face in view now, using the same alignment and embedding the live pipeline uses.
No face in view. Point the camera at the person and try again.
More than one face in view. Enrol one person at a time.
Face too small or turned too far. Move closer and look at the camera.
Could not locate the facial landmarks needed to align the face. Try better lighting.
No face model is loaded, so no embedding can be created.
Could not enrol that face. Try again.
